text: {"lessons":["My account has fluctuated modestly so far, so I should focus on preserving savings rather than chasing short-term gains.","Selling Stock C after a large loss did not prove that I can time the market; I should make future decisions based on the investment outlook, not just recent price moves.","Selling part of Stock E after a gain was a measured trade, and I should avoid frequent changes while keeping risk suitable for retirement."]}
